slots.coaching: Monday, low energy is fine: sit down and let one Lucy Dacus song play. You can stop after that.

card.name: Las Culturistas with Matt Rogers and Bowen Yang

slots.coaching: Tuesday night, put on Las Culturistas while you tidy or eat. One episode, no more required.
Wednesday, open My Name Is Why and read a few pages in bed. Ten minutes counts as the whole thing.
Thursday at 1pm, walk over to Ceremonia Bakeshop for something warm. In and out is enough.
Friday, queue up High Fidelity and watch a single episode. Lights off, phone away if you like.
Saturday moved to 6pm so Dokebi Bar and Grill fits your energy. Order whatever sounds good.
Sunday at 2pm, meet someone at Mozzarella Kosher. Send one text to lock it in — that's the hard part.

slots.coaching: Queue an episode while you make tea. One song's worth of listening is plenty.

card.name: A Little Devil in America: Notes in Praise of Black Performance

slots.coaching: Read two pages in bed. Close it whenever you like; the book isn't going anywhere.
Lunchtime suits this better than evening on a low day. Grab one warm thing and take it slow.
Start one episode Friday night. You can stop at the end of it, guilt-free.
Saturday morning, short walk, something savory. Then home again if that's all you've got.
Invite one person to meet you here Sunday afternoon. Being with someone is the point, not the food.
